outcome: Chronic hypoxic patterns of placental injury
Clusters of maternal floor multinucleate trophoblasts
cohort: 169 cases with placenta creta (PC) compared to 1661 cases without PC
finding: Placenta creta (PC) was significantly associated with various adverse pregnancy outcomes, suggesting it's a lesion of abnormal placental implantation and trophoblast invasion.
mod_finding: This study found that placentas with placenta creta were statistically significantly associated with cesarean sections compared to placentas without.
